p1.title: UQ 本周两条新闻整理
p1.body:
UQ 官网这周两条，我都读完了。

一条是总理科学奖里的创新奖，另一条是文学方向的写作奖金。

下面一张图一条，关键句贴了官网原文。

p2.title: UQ 教授拿了总理创新奖
p2.body:
11 月 25 号官网发的：UQ 分子生物科学研究所的 Mark Smythe 教授获 2026 Prime Minister’s Prize for Innovation。

原文：Professor Smythe has co-founded 6 companies, including Protagonist Therapeutics, Infensa Bioscience and Vast Bioscience, and has contributed to the development of 3 marketed drugs.

做科研也能做出公司，这条对读生物医药的同学挺有启发 🧪
p2.tags: #昆士兰大学 #UQ #生物医药 #澳洲读博 #澳洲大学

p3.title: 他带出了 50 多位科学家
p3.body:
UQ 校长在官网说，他 supported the development of more than 50 scientists who are now working in Australia and overseas.

我自己读研最纠结的就是走学术还是去业界，看到这种两条路都走通的例子会想多了解一下 IMB 的课题组。

想申 IMB 的同学可以先去看看组里在做什么。
p3.tags: #昆士兰大学 #UQ #选导师 #澳洲读研 #澳洲大学

mp.title: UQ 教授 Mark Smythe 获 2026 总理创新奖；UQ 讲师获首届 AustLit 写作奖金 $15,000
mp.lead: 本周 UQ 官网发布两条消息：IMB 的 Mark Smythe 教授获 2026 总理创新奖，以及 UQ 讲师 Allanah Hunt 博士获首届 AustLit Creative Writing Fellowship。下面逐条拆，原文都对着官网核过。

newsBodies.h2: 01 Mark Smythe 教授获 2026 总理创新奖
paragraphs: 11 月 25 日，UQ 官网发布：Professor Mark Smythe received the 2026 Prize for Innovation for delivering substantial health and economic benefits to Australia over a 30-year career.

Smythe 教授来自 UQ 分子生物科学研究所（IMB），同时是 Infensa Bioscience 的 CEO。官网原文：Professor Smythe has co-founded 6 companies, including Protagonist Therapeutics, Infensa Bioscience and Vast Bioscience, and has contributed to the development of 3 marketed drugs.
UQ 校长 Deborah Terry 教授在官网表示，他 supported the development of more than 50 scientists who are now working in Australia and overseas in key roles driving pharmaceutical innovation.

newsBodies.h2: 02 UQ 讲师获首届 AustLit 写作奖金
paragraphs: 11 月 23 日，UQ 官网发布：A University of Queensland academic is one of two recipients of the inaugural AustLit Creative Writing Fellowships, an initiative supporting Australian writers to create original works inspired by the nation's leading literary database.

官网原文：Dr Allanah Hunt, a queer Kurnu-Barkindji and Malyangapa writer, editor and UQ lecturer, and award-winning novelist Sophie Overett, will each receive $15,000 to develop their next writing projects using AustLit resources and datasets.
Hunt 博士的项目是一部以原住民视角为中心的短篇犯罪小说集，会使用 AustLit 的 BlackWords 数据集。AustLit 是设在 UQ 传播与艺术学院的澳洲文学在线数据库。
